tokenizer.description: Deterministic GPT-4/Claude-style BPE estimator (tiktoken unavailable): digit runs split into ceil(len/3) tokens (matching cl100k_base/o200k_base 3-digit number chunking), alphabetic/underscore words split into ceil(len/6) subwords, single punctuation delimiters counted as 1 token, whitespace merged into adjacent tokens except newlines. Also reports standard ceil(bytes/4) alongside.
